facts.statement: Announced: a chest just before the final obstacle of the Graveyard course needs 65 Thieving to picklock. It rarely gives the Fremennik Graceful ornament kit; otherwise it gives stackable Sunken treasure that can be traded for marks of grace with an NPC in Rellekka. The kit passed its poll (43,731 yes / 2,838 no / 602 skip).
facts.caveat: UPCOMING; pre-release design. The owner has Thieving 24. Never a route step.

Defence XP is 0, so none went to Defence; the Ernest lamp may be usable on Agility. Combat lamps must never go to Defence.
